Process automation

From paper registers to records teams can use.

I have created Excel sheets for department work that was previously recorded on paper. The aim: make entries easier to maintain, retrieve and review when internal or external audits need supporting records.

Structured entriesAccessible recordsEasier audit preparation
What I can help build nextVendor follow-up trackerMaintenance logInventory registerAudit evidence index

Workbook examples are not published here because departmental records may contain internal information.

✦How I approach a workflow01—03
01

Map the paper process

Identify what gets recorded, who updates it, and what an audit may need later.

02

Build the Excel record

Give each entry a consistent place so the team can sort, search and maintain it.

03

Make retrieval easier

Keep the record ready to review without searching through paper files.

A small system can remove a lot of repeat work.
